articles.title: U.S. military begins strikes on 'multiple targets' in Iran at Trump's direction
articles.description: President Donald Trump promised more attacks on Iran after strikes resumed this week. Earlier this week, he said a deal to end the war was near.

articles.title: Analysis: Trump said he loves inflation. Why that should be music to Kevin Warsh's ears
articles.description: The president said Wednesday he is happy with inflation at 4.2%. That will be welcome news for new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

articles.title: Trump keeps saying an Iran deal is close. Markets keep believing it
articles.description: Analysts still assume that, despite the continued conflict, a deal will eventually be reached that ends the war and reopens the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: ‘It will not bring you happiness’: I have advice for your single, childless 62-year-old multimillionaire reader
articles.description: “Go to Walmart and pay off someone’s layaway account.”

articles.title: Trump says U.S. secretly moved more than 100 million barrels of oil through Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: Trump's comments come after Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Tuesday that oil exports through Hormuz are "rising very meaningfully."

articles.title: Oil prices rise after Trump says U.S. will attack Iran 'very hard'
articles.description: Oil prices rose after the U.S. launched military strikes against Iran, raising concerns that renewed clashes may threaten shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Sen. Warren calls on SEC to delay SpaceX IPO, flagging concerns about valuation and governance
articles.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren noted Elon Musk's "uniquely unchecked" power as SpaceX's majority shareholder and other concerns in a letter to the SEC.

articles.title: Model who alleges Kanye West choked her tells BBC she felt 'suffocated and scared'
articles.description: West claims the encounter on a music video set was part of a "provocative theatrical performance".

articles.title: Murder of Lyhanna, 11, enrages France and turns up heat on government
articles.description: Protesters are angry that the suspect had already been reported to police last August in a separate case.
